sentences.en: The table is in the middle of the room.
I sit on a chair at the table.
sentences.zh: 我坐在桌子前的椅子上。

sentences.en: The bed is soft and warm.
I turn on the lamp when it is dark.
The books are on the shelf.
I put the glass on the table.
sentences.zh: 我把玻璃杯放在桌子上。

sentences.en: The plate is round and white.
I drink tea from a cup.
The bottle is full of water.
Put the things in the box.
The bag is on the floor.
I put fruit in the basket.
The glass on the shelf is empty.
The cushion on the chair is soft.
I put the kettle on the fire for tea.
sentences.zh: 我把水壶放在火上烧茶。

sentences.en: The curtain at the window is blue.
sentences.zh: 窗户上的窗帘是蓝色的。

sentences.en: I keep my boots in a special tray.
sentences.zh: 我把靴子放在一个特别的托盘里。

sentences.en: The lock on the door is broken.
Open the top drawer of the desk.
sentences.zh: 打开书桌的最上面抽屉。

sentences.en: The drain in the kitchen takes water away.
sentences.zh: 厨房里的排水管把水排走。

sentences.en: A cushion gives comfort when you sit.
sentences.zh: 坐垫在你坐的时候提供舒适。
